description:
The Wabi Classic Frameset combines Reynolds 725 steel, clean TIG welds, a brazed steel fork, and a rich wet-paint finish to create a simple, smooth, and versatile foundation. It’s hand-built with classic details and modern ride quality, making it a great starting point for almost any build.

Lightweight Steel Construction. The Classic uses heat-treated, double-butted Reynolds 725 chromoly steel to achieve a ride that’s both lively and surprisingly light for a steel frame. The oversized tubes are TIG-welded with clean, minimal lines that keep the frame responsive, comfortable, and quick on everything from relaxed spins to longer rides.

Artisan Craft & Finish. Every frame is hand-built by skilled artisans with roots in Japanese frame-building traditions. You can see it in the alignment, the smooth welds, and the overall finish. The frame gets a traditional wet-paint job followed by a clear coat, giving each color a deep, polished look.

All-Ride Geometry.

The Classic is balanced for just about anything. Its geometry offers long-distance comfort while still feeling quick and confident through city streets and tight corners. It stays smooth, predictable, and easy to trust no matter where you take it.

Precision Steel Fork. Performance Headset.

The tapered chromoly fork is brazed for strength and feel, with an investment-cast crown and forged fork ends for solid handling. It uses a 1-1/8" steerer for modern stiffness and comes with our Wabi Pro headset, made by FSA using their well-regarded Orbit-X design with sealed cartridge bearings.

Small Details for Real Use.

Extra-long forged track dropouts make wheel placement easy, and the integrated seatpost collar keeps the frame looking clean and classic. The frame also includes mounts for two bottle cages and discrete eyelets at the fork and rear dropouts if you want to add fenders or a rack.

Colors and Customization.

The Classic currently comes in Ion Blue, a dark metallic blue, and Willow Green, a glossy olive green. Custom colors are also available—see our FAQ for how that works. You can also choose a silver or black headset from the dropdown.

TECH SPECS AND NOTES

Includes: Frame, fork, complete headset, seatpost clamp, and bottle bolts.

Weight (55cm): 5.6 lbs (weight does not include headset or bolts).

Steerer: Threadless 1-1/8" steel steerer tube. Note: The steerer tube length is precut to match your frame size and allow approximately 35–40mm of spacers between the headset and stem.

Headset: Wabi Pro headset included with spacers, top cap, and installed star nut.

Brake Compatibility: Front and rear recessed caliper brake bolt mounts for short-reach brakes.

Tire Clearance: Ideal tire size is 28mm, but the frame can accept most 32mm tires.

Crankset Compatibility: Accommodates almost all track cranksets (tested to 135mm Q-factor). Note: The drive-side chainstay has a dimple to ensure crankarm spider and chainring clearance.

Eyelets: Eyelets at the inside of the front fork and inset at the rear dropouts. Note: Fender or rack installation may require modifications and/or spacers to fit properly.

Cable Stops: No cable stops on the frame. We recommend cable clips for a rear-brake installation.

COMPONENT SIZING

The Classic is designed around a 170mm crankarm, a 24mm setback seatpost, and stem lengths that change with frame size and rider height. You can find our recommendations under “Determining Bike Components Fit” on the sizing page. Using different parts may change the fit.

IMPORTANT NOTE ON COMPATIBILITY

We can only guarantee compatibility with the parts used on our complete bikes. If you’re planning a custom build, feel free to reach out—we’re happy to share anything we know—but we can’t offer refunds for issues with third-party components.
